title: JustTop
description: Quickly teleport to the highest block at your current coordinates. A simple and essential tool for every server.
body:
# 🏔️ JustTop
**Stop digging, start teleporting!**

JustTop is a lightweight utility for **1.21.x** that instantly teleports you to the surface. Whether you are stuck in a deep cave or at the bottom of a ravine, `/top` will bring you to safety.

### 🚀 Features
- **Surface Teleport:** Automatically finds the highest solid block at your X and Z coordinates.
- **Safety First:** Teleports you exactly on top of the block, preventing you from getting stuck.
- **Audio Feedback:** Features the classic XP pickup sound on success.

### 🛠 Commands & Permissions
- **/top** - Teleports you to the top. (**justtop.top**)

---

**JustTop** – *The shortest way to the surface. Just Top.*
